repairs.title: Cracked screens and glass
repairs.text: New glass or a new screen for a device that has taken a fall.

repairs.title: Tired batteries
repairs.text: A phone that is flat by lunchtime, shuts down with charge left, or has a battery that is visibly bulging.

repairs.title: Charging faults
repairs.text: A charger that no longer works, or a cable that must be held at an angle before the phone will charge.

repairs.title: Camera and rear panel
repairs.text: A scratched or split lens, soft pictures, or a rear panel that has shattered.

repairs.title: Speaker and microphone
repairs.text: A caller you can barely hear, a speaker that has gone thin, or a microphone that no longer picks you up.

repairs.title: After a soaking
repairs.text: Power the device down immediately, and bring it in without delay.

faq.a: No. Booking a visit is optional; it only means we expect you. You are welcome {{ hours_phrase }}
Those of Bell, Virgin Plus and Lucky Mobile. As a Bell Authorised Retailer we also arrange Bell home internet, TV and a home phone line.

faq.q: Can I bring my own phone?
faq.a: Yes. Bring the phone you have and we will set the plan up on it. A new phone is optional.

faq.q: What happens to my number if I change provider?
faq.a: It moves with you. Bring a recent bill, since the account number printed on it is what the transfer needs, and photo ID in case it is asked for. Leave the old plan in place: the transfer closes it.
The entrance has wheelchair access. If you need anything else, phone ahead and ask.
